items.title: UK Wades Into Tech Sovereignty Amid AI Policy Changes
items.summary: The UK is betting on domestic AI and cyber investment to reduce reliance on US tech — but security leaders question whether the funding is too fragmented and too late.

items.title: AI Gave Your Incident Archive a Second Job
items.summary: Security records are increasingly being used by vendors to train their models, creating new risks for enterprises.

items.title: Why Europe's Freezer Hacks Spread So Far, So Fast
items.summary: Europe's supermarket freezer hacks show how security issues can cascade across an industry, disrupting supply chains at scale.

items.title: UK Warns Its Critical Infrastructure Faces Grave Risk
items.summary: Britain's new Labour-led government is making a concerted push to get ahead of the AI risks to its national networks and the industrial complex.

items.title: Operação de influência russa tem como alvo generalizado a América Latina
items.summary: A operação, que contou com o uso de inteligência artificial, utilizou e-mails falsos, documentos governamentais falsificados e a criação de uma organização local para atacar escolas no Peru e no Equador, entre outras ações.

items.title: US Government Email Systems Open to Abuse Thanks to Typos
items.summary: Erroneous or outdated DNS records can give attackers surprising powers over organizations' email systems.

items.title: What We Missed: Knicks Phishing Test Goes Out of Bounds
items.summary: In this video conversation, Dark Reading editors discuss some of the news they didn't get a chance to cover, from an ill-conceived phishing simulation to a hacktivist attack on a US government agency.

items.title: APT29's Watering Holes Target Thousands of Mobile Users
items.summary: After compromising websites, the Russian state-sponsored threat group is fingerprinting victims, then harvesting information from the interesting ones.

items.title: SecurityDataPipeline.com Launches as a New Educational Resource for the AI Era
items.summary: The ungated resource explains how security data pipelines reduce SIEM ingestion costs, preserve detection coverage, and prepare the data layer for AI-driven security operations.

items.title: Critical Rails Bug Threatens to Derail Vulnerable Servers
items.summary: An attacker could write arbitrary files and read sensitive files via images uploaded to the Rails Active Storage ImageMagick integration, possibly positioning a threat actor for lateral movement.

items.title: Google, Partners Disrupt 1.3 Million-Device-Strong XCPE Botnet
items.summary: Android device manufacturer Videostrong allegedly ran the operation, which infected set-top boxes and IoT devices with a backdoor to create infrastructure for criminal activity.

items.title: Incidents Move Too Fast for Pen & Paper
items.summary: Organizations may not be ready for completely autonomous communication processes, but there are places where automating information updates would alleviate pressure.

items.title: Philippine Migrant Worker Data Likely Leaked in 69GB Government Breach
items.summary: An unknown operator appears to have exfiltrated SQL Server backups from the Philippine Overseas Employment Administration in under a half hour.

items.title: Phishing-Resistant Isn't Enough; Yubico Takes Aim at Identity-Verification Gap
items.summary: The new YubiID service bridges identity verification with credential enrollment and recovery across existing identity platforms, closing an important authentication gap. Plus: post-quantum YubiKey beta.

items.title: Fresh European Fridge Attacks Put Cold-Chain Security in Focus
items.summary: Beyond food storage, the same combination of Internet connectivity, remote access, and inadequate security practices can put temperature-controlled infrastructure across other critical sectors at risk.

items.title: Germany Busts 'Crime-as-a-Service' Investment Fraud Outfit
items.summary: Authorities seized more than 100 servers and arrested seven as part of a crackdown on a fraud network spanning more than 50 countries.

items.title: 9 Cyber Awareness Tips That Actually Match Today's Maze of Threats
items.summary: Practical guidance on safer search, stronger login security, better executive protection, and other habits can reduce enterprise risk.

items.title: LLMjacking Emerges as Thriving Cybercriminal Enterprise
items.summary: Cybercriminals have turned reselling cloud access to LLMs into a lucrative business model, with some victims paying as much as $1 million in resource consumption before access was revoked.

items.title: 3AM Affiliate Embraces AI-Like Loops in European School Attack
items.summary: Evidence suggests a model may have generated and revised commands during the ransom gang's breach, though researchers stopped short of claiming full automation.

items.title: One Compromised Laptop, Billions Lost: The Binance Attack-Path Warning
items.summary: The record theft shows how weak system separation, inadequate controls, and untested attack possibilities can turn one breach into systemic loss.
